name.baseName: Crude oil, market mix, at long distance transport

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Calculation for transport distances assuming transport by pipeline offshore and onshore as well as sea transport in tanker. Sites and modes of transportation based on the supply situation in 2023. UUID=de7649bb-5a94-3b3f-9d59-99112587f3e9

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Calculations include production and transport of crude oil from 23 countries.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Operation of crude oil pipelines by electricity.

# Included processes
Transportation of crude oil from exploration sites to refineries in ZA-region. Includes transport service requirements and emissions from oil handling and evaporation.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Literature. Online calculators for distances. The consumption mix is calculated based on international trade statistics for 2023.
